$comment: ANTI-mirror map for backend/galaxy <-> frontend/lib/galaxy (openspec:
replace-observation-with-sightings, tasks.md 4.13 / galaxy-view spec.md
'A Galaxy Link's Id Is Its Lane's Stable Id' — 'A cross-stack fixture
pins the equality under the Go-sole-authority regime'). backend/galaxy's
lane-id derivation (LaneIdBetween, laneIdFor, SystemIdFor/
CellForSystemId) is server-only math with no TypeScript mirror, now or
ever — the frontend consumes the WIRE VALUE (a lane's served `id`,
a gate body's served `laneId`, a fleet's served `laneId`), never
re-derives it from raw coordinates. This file is what wires
fixtures/galaxy/cases.json's laneIdEquality family into
.claude/scripts/check-mirror-map.sh's coverage sweep, mirroring
fixtures/space/mirror-map.json, fixtures/system/mirror-map.json, and
fixtures/fleet/mirror-map.json — the three existing anti-mirror maps.
This is the INVERSE of fixtures/market/mirror-map.json, the capability's
one remaining mirrored-pair map. That one asserts a mirror EXISTS and is
covered. This one asserts a mirror does NOT exist: check-mirror-map.sh's
anti_mirror pass over this map fails if any function name is declared in
BOTH backend/galaxy and frontend/lib/galaxy unless it is listed in
'sharedNames'. There is deliberately no 'pairs' array — a pairs entry
would assert the very mirror this designation forbids.
frontend/lib/galaxy does not exist and is not expected to: galaxy-tier
wire types live at frontend/lib/types/galaxy.ts and
frontend/lib/services/galaxy-service.ts (the wire-shape/apiClient layer),
not a computed-math mirror package of the same shape as lib/market — so
the anti_mirror check currently passes trivially on the
'TS_DIR does not exist' branch. Should a frontend/lib/galaxy ever be
created for rule-bearing math (as opposed to wire types), that is the
moment this map's anti-mirror designation needs re-litigating, not
silently satisfied.
'sharedNames' is empty BY DEFAULT and should stay that way. Adding a name
here is a claim that a render-side function may legitimately share a name
with an authoritative Go one; it needs the same scrutiny as a spec change.
